SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
Riverside Endoscopy Unit (fictional)
Upper Endoscopy and Colonoscopy Report
Date of service: 2026-10-30
Endoscopist: Synthetic Endoscopist, MD (fictional)
Sedation: propofol by a CRNA (fictional)
UPPER ENDOSCOPY
The gastroscope was advanced to the second part of the duodenum. Cold forceps biopsies were taken from the gastric antrum
and sent as specimen 1.
COLONOSCOPY
The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum and the ileocecal valve was identified.
Bowel preparation
Good
FINDINGS AND THERAPY
Polyp A - transverse colon: a 4 mm sessile polyp was removed with cold forceps and sent as specimen 2.
Polyp B - rectum: a 9 mm pedunculated polyp was removed with a hot snare and sent as specimen 3.
No snare was used on Polyp A.
No forceps biopsy was taken from Polyp B.
Two hemoclips were placed at the Polyp B polypectomy site to prevent delayed bleeding.
Impression: antral biopsies; two colon polyps removed.
